answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 151361 Country: india Title: Reading quran front of mayyat Question: Can we read Quran nearby mayyat? I am from Kerala so, if the reply is in Malayalam it will be better. Answer ID: 151361 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1208/1170/L=9/1438) It is makrooh to recite the Holy Quran loudly near the dead body before its ghusl. If the dead body had been given ghusl then it is not makrooh. قال فى الدر المختار : وكره قراءة القرآن عنده إلى تمام غسله . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
